command: fabio semantic-model generate-dax --workspace <WS> --id <MODEL> --prompt "total revenue by region" [--execute]
description: Translate a natural-language prompt into DAX using the remote Power BI MCP server's Copilot NL2DAX engine (GenerateQuery tool). With --execute, the generated DAX is also run via executeQueries and the rows are returned. Requires the PowerBIMCP tenant setting + a Copilot license. Read-only.

data.dax:
// Total revenue by region
DEFINE
  MEASURE 'factsales'[Total Revenue] = SUM('factsales'[RevenueUSD])
EVALUATE
  SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'dimstore'[Region],
    "Total Revenue",
    [Total Revenue]
  )
  ORDER BY 'dimstore'[Region] ASC
data.note: Copilot-generated DAX. Run it with: fabio semantic-model query --id <ID> --dax '<DAX>' (or re-run with --execute).

notes: With --execute, the response is instead the executed rows (same shape as `semantic-model query`), e.g. [{"Sales[Country]":"France","[Total Revenue]":309.83}, ...]. The endpoint is the fixed global URL {fabricBase}/mcp/powerbi; --workspace is kept for group consistency but the tool resolves the model by GUID. GetSemanticModelSchema (copilot-schema) and GetReportMetadata (report copilot-metadata) return multiple content blocks that fabio merges into one object.
query_examples: fabio semantic-model generate-dax --id <MODEL> --prompt "top 3 products by revenue" --query dax -o plain
fabio semantic-model generate-dax --id <MODEL> --prompt "total revenue by country" --execute
